title: Model ecosystem cartography and customer usage scenarios
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Context: As open and hosted model options proliferate, sales and platform teams repeatedly ask two questions: (1) Which models are good fits for specific customer personas and production scenarios? (2) Where are our fallback and procurement risks (licensing, quantization, latency, regional availability)? This ticket will produce a practical, mapped artifact that connects model capabilities and constraints to 6 canonical customer usage scenarios (RAG for SMBs, real-time chat, high-throughput embeddings for search, batch summarization for regulated customers, on-prem compliance lanes, and multimodal assistants).

Scope: Produce a single-source CSV and an interactive visualization that maps ~40 candidate models across 10 axes: latency bucket, token cost, embedding quality rank (internal benchmark), quantization friendliness, license risk (commercial/restrictive), enterprise-variant availability, on-prem support, regional infra footprint, observed hallucination rate (bench), and known security controls (KMS/HSM). Also produce 50 prioritized model->customer persona recommendations with notes and 3 validated customer interviews.

Deliverables: (1) model-ecosystem-cartography.csv (columns described above), (2) interactive deck/visualization (Tableau/Observable notebook) for GTM and ENG, (3) 1-pager playbook mapping persona -> recommended model flavors and fallback rules, (4) short RFC for ENG about instrumenting signals we used (latency telemetry, embedding drift).

Acceptance criteria: 1) CSV contains at least 40 models with non-empty values for the 10 axes. 2) Visualization is accessible to GTM and ENG links in Confluence. 3) 50 model->persona recommendations with rationale and fallback. 4) 3 customer interviews recorded and summarized in Drive. 5) PR to research repo with benchmark code and dataset (reproducible).

Methodology: Combine internal benchmark outputs (embedding microbench, generation Hallucination score runs), third-party signal scraping (model release notes, license text), and qualitative field interviews. We will prioritize models that appear in our serving catalog and those flagged by Sales as high-frequency asks.

Artifacts and links: Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RWD/Model+Ecosystem+Cartography, Drive spreadsheet: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-cartography, Research PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/research/pull/458, Market dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/s/market-models
success_metrics: CSV + viz delivered; 50 prioritized recommendations; 3 validated customer interviews; GTM and ENG adoption (tracked via follow-up meeting and dashboard views > 10); RFC accepted by ENG.
